messages:
Priya (Finance): Heads up 50k in retro credits posted today from a pricing experiment that ran Dec 10-20. Billing applied credits to Jan invoices but discounts relate to usage in Dec. Need month-end treatment: estimate accrual vs prior-period correction? :thinking:
Leo (Billing): Confirmed: Promo code PX-DEC retro-applied after reconciliation. Credit memos created (CM-6012..CM-6030) and applied to invoices dated 2026-01-12 to 2026-01-20. Total credits = $49,700. Links: https://billing.redwood/cm/6012, https://billing.redwood/px-dec-summary.pdf
Nina (Revenue Ops): Important: experiment required retrospective discount because usage was mis-tagged. Revenue recognition should reflect Dec usage reduction. Two options: (1) Prior-period adjustment to Dec recognized revenue, (2) Current-period correcting JE moving amount into Dec deferred bucket. Audit prefers option 2 when immaterial; please check materiality.
Carlos (Controller): Materiality threshold at Redwood = 1% of monthly recurring revenue. Dec recognized revenue = $3.9M, so $49.7k is ~1.27% 5 just above threshold. We need to disclose if prior-period adjustment? But could we aggregate with other small items? Need to quantify.
Priya (Finance): Quick calc: monthly run-rate ~ $3.9M, annualized ~ $46.8M. Single item is close to the 1% MR threshold. Suggest we prepare both: draft prior-period adjustment memo and a fallback correcting JE if auditors accept current-period. I'll prepare numbers.
Leo (Billing): Operational note: credits were auto-applied by the billing job on 2026-01-21. We have full CM PDFs and experiment approval ticket in Jira: https://jira.redwood/billing/EXP-142.
Nina (Revenue Ops): If we do prior-period adjustment, revenue schedules and ARR will move. Need Leader approval + disclosure in notes. If we do correcting JE, we must update schedules and include narrative tying to PX-DEC experiment.
Priya (Finance): Draft JE for correcting approach (post in Feb, reclass to Dec):
```
Date: 2026-02-28
DR Recognized Revenue (GL 4000) ...... $49,700
CR Accounts Receivable (GL 1100) ..... $49,700
-- reverse the revenue reduction that happened when credits applied to Jan invoices
Date: 2026-02-28
DR Accounts Receivable (GL 1100) ..... $49,700
CR Deferred Revenue (GL 2100) ........ $49,700
-- reclass to Dec deferred/unearned to reflect discount relating to Dec usage
Reference: PX-DEC retro credits CM-6012..CM-6030; support: PX-DEC experiment ticket EXP-142; billing job logs attached
```
Carlos (Controller): Good draft. But because this exceeds threshold we should run the prior-period adjustment memo and ask external auditors if they'd accept a current JE disclosure. I'll loop in audit. Also include population-level test evidence showing impact by customer segment.
Priya (Finance): I'll assemble packet: summary of experiment, list of affected customers, CM PDFs, Jira link, net impact by revenue stream, and proposed journal. Targeting to send to auditors by EOD.
audit-bot: Audit request logged: AR-REQ-3345. Please upload supporting docs to /audit/AR-REQ-3345 within 48 hours.
Nina (Revenue Ops): If auditors push back, we'll post a prior-period adjustment effective Dec 31 and file corrected financials for internal reporting. Heads up to FP&A for guidance on forecasts.
Leo (Billing): I'll export the CM list and attach CSV to the audit packet. Also flag billing job for hotfix so future retro promos are tagged to the correct period.
Carlos (Controller): Approved plan: prepare auditor packet + proposed correcting JE. Priya, route to me and Jared if needed. We'll decide after auditor response. Keep month-close timeline tight.
Priya (Finance): Will do. I'll update month-end checklist and mark this item as "Pending audit guidance". Will post final decision in this thread. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
